cup.method: Bounded LM prototype: 300 iterations, centered differences 1e-5, initial damping 1e-10, no endpoint attractor. All mesh edges are auxiliary hinges; absolute crease angles stay in [-pi,pi]. Driver is the angle between front/back material normals. Four deterministic signed seeds have magnitude .01,.01,.3,.3.
